races.name: Human
races.description: The most adaptable and ambitious of the common peoples, found in every corner of the world and rarely content to stay put.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Stout, stubborn folk of stone and forge, famed for their endurance, their grudges, and their darkvision.

races.name: Hill Dwarf
races.description: A dwarf of the highland clans, hardier of body and keener of sense than her deep-delving cousins.

races.name: Mountain Dwarf
races.description: A dwarf raised among the high peaks, trained to armor and axe from childhood.

races.name: Elf
races.description: A graceful, long-lived people with an otherworldly poise; elves trance rather than sleep and remember centuries.

races.name: High Elf
races.description: An elf of keen mind and old magic, schooled in a cantrip almost before learning to walk.

races.name: Wood Elf
races.description: An elf of the deep forest, swift, silent, and near invisible among the trees.

races.name: Drow
races.description: A dark elf of the Underdark, gifted with innate magic and cursed with sensitivity to the sun.

races.name: Halfling
races.description: Small, cheerful, and improbably lucky folk who value hearth and good food above glory.

races.name: Lightfoot Halfling
races.description: A halfling with a talent for slipping out of sight behind anyone larger than herself.

races.name: Stout Halfling
races.description: A halfling of hardy stock, resistant to poison and hard to knock down.

races.name: Dragonborn
races.description: Proud, draconic humanoids who carry the breath weapon and resistance of their ancestors' bloodline.

races.name: Gnome
races.description: Small, inventive, and irrepressibly curious, with a mind resistant to magical intrusion.

races.name: Forest Gnome
races.description: A gnome who speaks with small beasts and hides where no one thinks to look.

races.name: Rock Gnome
races.description: A gnome tinkerer whose pockets are always full of half-built clockwork.

races.name: Half-Elf
races.description: Caught between two worlds and belonging fully to neither, half-elves make superb diplomats and wanderers.

races.name: Half-Orc
races.description: Powerfully built and quick to anger, a half-orc refuses to fall while there is still a fight to be had.

races.name: Orc
races.description: A relentless warrior people, built for the charge and famous for shrugging off wounds that would fell others.

races.name: Tiefling
races.description: Descendants of an infernal bargain, marked by horns and tail and born with fire in their blood.

races.name: Aasimar
races.description: A mortal touched by the upper planes, carrying a light that can be unleashed in moments of need.

races.name: Goliath
races.description: Mountain-born giants among humanoids, raised to carry crushing loads and endure brutal cold.

races.name: Goblin
races.description: Small, quick and far tougher than their size suggests. Goblin childhood is a competition and the prize is being alive at the end of it, which leaves the survivors with a very particular attitude to danger.

races.name: Revenant
races.description: One who died and did not stay dead. The body that walks back is rarely the body that fell - it comes back larger, marked, and carrying more than one voice. Revenants remember their old life only in fragments, usually as dreams.
